opening: The insides of both my cheeks have turned blackish.
Several of my fingernails have brownish-black discoloration.
My toenails have dark streaks running along them too.
I have bullous pemphigoid; it's in remission, and I'm here for my routine follow-up.

opening.text: I'm here for my routine follow-up for bullous pemphigoid, which is in remission. I'm a 63-year-old White woman. I've noticed the insides of both my cheeks have turned blackish, and it has been gradually increasing. Also, several of my fingernails have brownish-black discoloration, and my toenails have dark streaks running along them too.
